\node[card] (cover) {\heading{1}{可変尺度のHausdorff被覆}{Variable-scale Hausdorff cover}

\flow{cover}{finite}{\Tx{外測度の可算劣加法性、最大分離集合、有限選択}{Countable outer subadditivity, maximal separated set, finite selection}\\[3pt]\Cite{finite-selection}};

\flow{density}{endpoint}{\Tx{最大化の一方向比較をcrop後の密度条件へ移す}{Transport one-sided maximizing inequalities through the crop}\\[3pt]\Cite{profile-selection}};
